description: Use mode client_comparison with a base currency and dated, sourced caller-supplied quotes to compare against ECB reference rates within ECB coverage. Returns per-currency differences, source dates and capture metadata. The caller quote is not an independent market feed. Unsupported legacy feed requests are rejected; quote accuracy, provenance and redistribution rights remain unverified. Source: ECB, free of charge at ecb.europa.eu; values derived by SYNTHORA; rates not for transactions. [x402: 0.03 USDC per call on Base]
